rows.claim: If you meant one weight per region instead, the number would differ
rows.evidence: The agent never computed the alternative (one weight per region, i.e. weighted mean of region means with weights 1.6, 1.3, 2.1, 0.8). No tool output shows that value or compares it to 3.448. It is plausible given unequal region counts (apac 199, emea 128, latam 81, na 42), but no output verifies it.
